subslides.chapter: sq(/ C D /) = sq(/ C A /) + sq(/ A D /) + 2·rect(/ C A /, / A D /)
subslides.symbolic: sq(/ C D /) = sq(/ C A /) + sq(/ A D /) + 2·rect(/ C A /, / A D /)
subslides.clause_html:
/ C D / = / C A / + / A D / → sq(/ C D /) =
sq(/ C A /) + sq(/ A D /) + 2·rect(/ C A /, / A D /)
subslides.just_title: If a segment be cut at random, the square on the whole equals the squares on the segments plus twice the rectangle contained by them.

subslides.chapter: add sq(/ D B /) to both sides
subslides.symbolic: sq(/ C D /) + sq(/ D B /) = sq(/ C A /) + sq(/ A D /) + sq(/ D B /) + 2·rect(/ C A /, / A D /)
subslides.clause_html:
Add sq(/ D B /) to each: sq(/ C D /) + sq(/ D B /) =
sq(/ C A /) + sq(/ A D /) + sq(/ D B /) + 2·rect(/ C A /, / A D /)
subslides.just_title: If equals be added to equals, the wholes are equal.

subslides.chapter: right triangles < C B D > and < A B D > by I.47
subslides.symbolic: sq(/ C B /) = sq(/ C D /) + sq(/ D B /), sq(/ A B /) = sq(/ A D /) + sq(/ D B /)

< C D B ) = ∟ → sq(/ C B /) = sq(/ C D /) + sq(/ D B /)
and sq(/ A B /) = sq(/ A D /) + sq(/ D B /)
subslides.just_title: In right-angled triangles the square on the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares on the two legs.
